lines.fight.open: {foeName} steps into the open and holds still.
lines.fight.telegraph: {foeName} shows where the next blow will fall.
lines.fight.timeout: The fight with {foeName} goes on until both are spent.
lines.timeout_even: {name} and {foeName} break off together. Neither one takes the ground.
lines.fight.defend.held: {name} catches the miss and does not answer {foeName}.
lines.standoff.humans: {foeName} keep their spears up and watch {name}.
lines.standoff.flee.fail: A spear cuts {name} deeply, and what {name} carried falls.
lines.spar.stop: {name} and {foeName} stop while both can still stand.
lines.hunt.injury.minor: {name} takes a small hurt from the large prey.
lines.hunt.injury.serious: {name} takes a deep hurt from the large prey.
lines.hunt.injury.crippling: {name} takes a lasting hurt from the large prey.
lines.showdown.untouched: The showdown with {foeName} is left as it was.
